L1_parent_id_unbound_from_parent_hash.note: parent_genome_id is NOT part of the eleven-component evaluation identity; only parent_genome_hash is. A record can name any parent it likes and still reproduce every stored hash.

L1b_parent_hash_swapped_to_a_different_s.note: no cross-check that parent_genome_hash is the hash of parent_genome_id

L2_mutation_hash_reroll_gives_a_free_res.note: mutation_hash is caller-supplied and never derived from gene_changes, so a search that re-proposes the same edge under a new proposal id gets an independent draw under a stochastic evaluator with no multiplicity accounting

L3_gene_changes_not_cross_checked.unknown_gene_fails_closed: BLOCKED: no declared InterventionClass for gene(s) ['a_future_ontology_gene']. Add them to GENE_INTERVENTION_CLASS with their tru
L3_gene_changes_not_cross_checked.note: InterventionClass is derived from the DECLARED gene list, not from diffing parent_genome_hash against child_genome_hash; the derivation is only as honest as the declaration it reads. Today the table is single-valued (every gene R_ONLY) so a false declaration cannot yet change the class -- it becomes exploitable the moment a non-R_ONLY gene is added, which is exactly what the module's own comment warns about.

L4_rescoring_guard.same_identity_different_result: BLOCKED: M-0d91d015350081da8528 already has a record under this identity with a different result_hash (913c3329f79d9a1e vs d0dd2f0fcf02ba31); the pipeline is n

L5_promoted_flag_flipped_after_the_fact.naive_in_place_edit: BLOCKED: record M-0d91d015350081da8528 does not reproduce its stored content_hash
L5_promoted_flag_flipped_after_the_fact.note: hashes are self-referential, not chained and not signed, so recomputing them is sufficient; there is no prev_hash, no manifest attestation and no append log

L6_delete_then_rewrite.note: the append-only guarantee is the in-memory index rebuilt from a directory glob; removing the file removes the memory. No log, no manifest, no chain.

L7_rows_file_detached.docstring_claim: spec section 4 says a record whose rows file is absent is a summary, not a fitness record, and a summary cannot be re-analysed at a different granularity
L7_rows_file_detached.note: nothing on the read path checks that the rows file exists or matches the record

L8_cross_condition_pooling.note: sharding by condition_id is real, but records() globs */lfm-*.json across every shard and summary() pools them into one manifest_hash with no condition partition; the CROSS_CONDITION refusal never fires because it is keyed on record_id, which already contains the condition components
